title: Middle East live: US envoy Kushner to meet Netanyahu after talks with Hamas
summary: US envoy Jared Kushner on Monday meets Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following talks with Hamas leaders in Egypt aimed at reviving a US-backed Gaza peace plan that Israel has so far rejected. Follow our live blog for the latest updates.
contentText: The prime minister's office in Iraqi Kurdistan was targeted by two Iranian drones overnight, authorities said Monday. The attacks were launched from Iranian territory and no casualties were reported, the Kurdistan Regional ​Government security agency said. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.
